meta.notes: No own website found (website null). Family office of Bobela, Dobrovský, Pudil (not a classic VC); invests in energy, real estate, chemicals and biotech/diagnostics start-ups. E15 article dated 13 Mar 2021 in page text but no date shown to fetcher reliably, so published_date null; the e15 type/sector sources are undated in record. hq_country inferred from registered seat (team location not published). Only dated deal found: Powerful Medical seed (Sep 2022; cc.cz 30.9.2022 confirms 'BPD Partners ... spravuje peníze někdejších majitelů Czech Coal'). CB Insights lists a 2024 Powerful Medical entry for BPD Partners but it is an aggregator and unconfirmed by a primary source; 2024 EIC round did not name bpd. Linked BTCZ Ventures (own record) is described by IOCB Prague as 'part of BPD Partners Group' and supported Taveren Therapeutics (2025-12-03); not recorded here as direct BPD investment because the source names BTCZ, not bpd partners. Registry entry shows it is also licensed for investment services and real-estate rental (finmag mirror, not in ČNB JERRS checked). Funds/ticket/stages not published.
